paite: Huan TOUPA'N Samuel kiang Huansraelite kummipang ka deih louhsa Saul ziak in bang tan ahia na lungkham ding? Na kii ah sathau thundim inla, kuan in. Bethlehem mi Jesse kiang ah ka hon sawl ding. Atapate lak a mi kumpipa ding in ka sep khinta hi," achi hi.
heading: David Kumpipa Dia Thaunilh Ahi
english: Yahweh said to Samuel, “How long will you mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him from being king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil, and go. I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I have provided a king for myself among his sons.”

paite: Samuel in, "Bangchi in ka kuan thei dia? Saul in ana zaleh hon that ding," achi hi. TOUPA'N, "Bawngla hon pi inla, TOUPA kiang a kithoih dia hong ka hi," chi in.
english: Samuel said, “How can I go? If Saul hears it, he will kill me.” Yahweh said, “Take a heifer with you, and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to Yahweh.’

paite: "Kithoihna ah Jesse sam inla, na hih ding ka hon hilh ding. Amin ka hon hilh dingpa sathau hon nilhsak in," achi hi.
english: Call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you shall do. You shall anoint to me him whom I name to you.”

paite: Samuel in TOUPA gen bang in ahih a, Bethlehem ah ahohta hi. Khua a upate'n ling kawm in amah ana dawn ua, "Hoih lam thu a hong na hi maw?" achi uh. Ama'n, "Hoih lam thu ah hi e,” achi hi.
english: Samuel did that which Yahweh spoke, and came to Bethlehem. The elders of the city came to meet him trembling, and said, “Do you come peaceably?”

paite: "TOUPA kiang a kithoih dia hong ka hi. Kisiangsak unla kithoihna ah hong pai sam un," achi hi. Jesse leh atapate asiangsak a, kithoihna ah asam hi.
english: He said, “Peaceably; I have come to sacrifice to Yahweh. Sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice.” He sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ahong pai un Eliab ana en a, "TOUPA sathau nilhpa ama a ompa ahi mahmah ve," achi hi.
english: When they had come, he looked at Eliab, and said, “Surely Yahweh’s anointed is before him.”

paite: Himahleh ToUPA'N Samuel kiang ah, "Amel in hiam, asandan hiam in en ke'n. Ke'n amah ka deih kei hi. TOUPA'N mihing et bang in a-en kei. Mihing in polam a kilatdan a-en a, TOUPA'N bel lungtang a-en zaw hi,” achi hi.
english: But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but Yahweh looks at the heart.”

paite: Jesse in Abinadab asam a, Samuel ma ah apaisak hi. Ama'n, "Hiai leng TOUPA tel ahi nai kei,” achi hi.
english: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”

paite: Jesse in Shammah ava paisak nawn hi. Ama'n, "Hiai leng TOUPA tel ahi nai kei lai," achi hi.
english: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”

paite: Huchi in Jesse in atapa sagihte Samuel ma ah apaisak nawn hi. Samuel in Jesse kiang ah, "TOUPA'N hiaite atel kei," achi hi.
english: Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. Samuel said to Jesse, “Yahweh has not chosen these.”

paite: Samuel in Jesse kiang ah, "Hiai ah na tapate a-om kim vek uhia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Anaupangpen a-om lai, ngai in, ama'n belam aching hi," achi hi. Samuel in Jesse kiang ah, "Va samsak dih ve; ahong tun masiah i tu kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Samuel said to Jesse, “Are all your children here?” He said, “There remains yet the youngest. Behold, he is keeping the sheep.” Samuel said to Jesse, “Send and get him, for we will not sit down until he comes here.”

paite: Huchi in ava samsak a, amah ahon pi uhi. Amah bel san thiuhtheuh, mit hah kilawm leh melhoihtak ahi. "TOUPA'N, thou inla, sathau nilh in, hiai amah ahi,” achi hi.
english: He sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, with a handsome face and good appearance. Yahweh said, “Arise! Anoint him, for this is he.”

paite: Samuel in sathau bawm kii ala a, a-unaute lak ah amah sathau anilh hi. TOUPA Kha huai ni a pan nakpitak in David tung ah ahong tungta. Samuel athou a, Ramah ah apaita hi.
english: Then Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the middle of his brothers. Then Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up and went to Ramah.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA Kha in Saul apawtsan a, TOUPA sawl kha gilou in amah ahihbuai hi.
heading: Kumpi Saul Inn Ah David
english: Now Yahweh’s Spirit departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from Yahweh troubled him.

paite: Saul sikhate'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, Pathian sawl kha gilou in nang hon hihbuai hi.
english: Saul’s servants said to him, “See now, an evil spirit from God troubles you.

paite: Ka toupa un na ma a om na sikhate kaihging tumsiamtak mi zon thu hon pe dih ve. Pathian sawl kha gilou in ahon mat chiang in atum dia, na hoih mai ding," achi uhi.
english: Let our lord now command your servants who are in front of you to seek out a man who is a skillful player on the harp. Then when the evil spirit from God is on you, he will play with his hand, and you will be well.”

paite: Saul in asikhate kiang ah, "Tumsiamtak mi hon zonsak unla, ka kiang ah hon pi un," achi hi.
english: Saul said to his servants, “Provide me now a man who can play well, and bring him to me.”

paite: Asikhate lak a khat in adawng a, akiang ah, "Ngai dih, Bethlehem mi Jesse tapa khat ka muta a, huai mi tumsiamtak, mihangsantak, kidoumi, thugen siam, melhoihtak ahi a, akiang ah TOUPA a om hi," achi hi.
english: Then one of the young men answered and said, “Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite who is skillful in playing, a mighty man of valor, a man of war, prudent in speech, and a handsome person; and Yahweh is with him.”

paite: Saul in Jesse kiang ah mi asawl a, "Na tapa David belamching a om ka kiang ah hon hohsak in," achi hi.
english: Therefore Saul sent messengers to Jesse, and said, “Send me David your son, who is with the sheep.”

paite: Jesse in sabiltung, tanghou leh uain thawl khat leh kelnou ala a, Saul piak ding in atapa David aposak hi.
english: Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, a container of wine, and a young goat, and sent them by David his son to Saul.

paite: Saul kiang ah David ava tung a, ama ah ava dingh hi. Ama'n ana it mahmah a, agalvan tawipa in apangsak hi.
english: David came to Saul and stood before him. He loved him greatly; and he became his armor bearer.

paite: Saul in Jesse kiang ah, "David ka kiang ah om hen, ka mit atung mahmah hi," chi a hilh ding in mi asawl hi.
english: Saul sent to Jesse, saying, “Please let David stand before me, for he has found favor in my sight.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul tung a Pathian sawl dawi ahong om chiang in David in kaihging ala a, atum zel hi. Huchi in Saul ahong halh a, ahoih a; dawi in apawtsan hi.
english: When the spirit from God was on Saul, David took the harp and played with his hand; so Saul was refreshed and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.
